english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for eating utensils, including knives, forks and spoons.
Use this for eating utensils, rather than general kitchen equipment.
Use 餐具 for dishes and other tableware considered collectively.

examples.english: Remember to set out the silverware before eating.
examples.jyutping: sik6 faan6 cin4 gei3 dak1 baai2 hou2 caan1 geoi6

examples.english: Before eating at the buffet, remember to pick up a utensil.
examples.traditional: 食自助餐之前，記得攞一件餐具。
examples.jyutping: sik6 zi6 zo6 caan1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 lo2 jat1 gin6 caan1 geoi6

examples.english: Remember to put the plate and other tableware back in the drawer after eating.
examples.traditional: 食完飯記得將餐具放返入櫃桶。
examples.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 gei3 dak1 zoeng1 caan1 geoi6 fong3 faan1 jap6 gwai6 tung2
